## Pre-registered effects (arm full)

1. Maximum block span >= 20: 19.5 -> **fails**.
2. First session with span >= 80 in [250, 865]: per seed [None, None, None] -> **fails, never**; span at 865 15.4 [13.7-16.4] (DD 104).
3. 4-digit error > 3-digit error (250-865): 0.296 vs 0.214 -> **holds** (EPAM 3.0% vs 1.5%).
4. Prior speeds early learning (span s50 full vs prioroff): 10.4 vs 9.1 -> **holds**.
5. Letter probe final <= 9 at every probe: max 11 -> **fails**.
